definitions: To make a long, thin cut or mark on a surface with a sharp object.
To rub an itchy part of one's body with one's fingernails or a sharp object.
To cancel or remove something from a list or schedule.
To withdraw from a competition or race.
examples: I need to scratch this mosquito bite.
They decided to scratch the last item from the agenda.
The horse had to scratch from the race due to injury.
